message.content:
The cover of Tempo magazine, dated 10-16 April 2017, features a medium-shot photograph of a woman with long brown hair, looking down with her eyes closed or cast downward. She is positioned centrally, slightly behind a vertical metal pole with a black top. To her right, the torso and arm of a person in black tactical gear and a dark vest are visible. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, white, serif capital letters across the upper portion, partially obscured by the woman’s head. Below this, smaller white text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above the main title, "TAKTIK OESMAN SAPTA KUASAI DPD" is written in white.

A red rectangle in the lower-left contains the white word "INVESTIGASI". Below this, large black text on a yellow gradient background reads "SITI AISYAH DAN PEMBUNUHAN KIM JONG-NAM". Further down, smaller black text describes an Indonesian migrant worker and Pyongyang intelligence. The bottom-right corner shows a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302", "00007", the price "RP 45.000", and other publishing details. A red border runs along the left edge.
